content.bridge_context: Learning how to separate mixtures into their individual parts using simple techniques.

units.title: What is a Mixture?
units.explanation: A combination of two or more substances that can be separated by physical means.
units.dual_language_instruction: Think of salt mixed with sand. Can you get the salt back? / नमक और रेत के मिश्रण के बारे में सोचें। क्या आप नमक वापस पा सकते हैं?

units.title: Why Separate?
units.explanation: We separate mixtures to remove impurities or to get useful components (like cream from milk).
units.dual_language_instruction: Why do we use a tea strainer? / हम चाय की छलनी का उपयोग क्यों करते हैं?
